placement.note: the pools stand on the site's grid, about 29° east of north

heightM.note: the plaza trees' crowns above the street (the raised plaza plus the trees): the model's top

plaza.note: the memorial plaza's width and length, proportioned by eye

poolM.note: each reflecting pool's side, the commonly published 176 ft (about an acre); Wikidata gives no dimensions

poolSpacingM.note: between the two pools' centres, standing in the original towers' footprints

voidM.note: the central void's side in each pool

readabilityScale.note: Muted and still (CLAUDE.md memorial rules): grey stone, dark water and voids, a dark parapet, plain trees. No emissive, no animation, no text.

gameScale.note: Real scale: a memorial is not exaggerated; its plaza raised 2 m so the pools can be cut into it above the game's solid land.
